dictionary_path.description: Path to the ChaSen dictionary directory

model_path.description: Path to the ChaSen language model file

input_encoding.description: Character encoding of input: e=EUC-JP, s=Shift_JIS, w=UTF-8, u=UTF-8, a=ISO-8859-1

options.description: List of command-line flags to enable (e.g., 's' for partial sentence mode, 'j' for Japanese mode, 'b' best path, 'e' full morpheme data). Must be single-character strings matching documented options (e.g., 's','j','b','m','p','f','e','c','d','v','O','F','i','o','w','r','R','L','lp','lt','lf','h','V').
